keySentence: She promised to be his friend.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: She promised the frog. The frog found the ball. She was happy. She promised to be his friend.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: The princess agreed and made a deal with the frog. She promised to be his friend if he found the ball. The frog dived deep into the well and came back with it. The princess grabbed her golden ball and ran to the castle. She forgot about her promise to the little frog. The frog called after her but she did not look back.
